name: ascet_code_read
description: Read saved ASCET content with one actual ref string or an actual array of 1-32 refs. No operation argument; never JSON.stringify refs. Text returns code, Diagram returns diagram_text, bindings return method_binding. BDE objects return a local neighborhood with real Pins/connections/boundaries and referenced_component_path. State/Transition objects return saved relationships and code_slots refs; read those refs for source. Batch reads share one 128 KiB budget, preserve order and reuse Component reads. Continue with only cursor; batch items have individual next_cursor. For branch/order claims read the complete Method, consuming all pages. Component refs are scope-only. One root status; inspect partial/issues and batch errors. SOURCE_CHANGED needs new discovery; malformed arguments need correction without rediscovery.

ref.description: One actual ref string returned by search, find or read; alternatively an actual JSON array of 1-32 same-session ref strings. Copy the string unchanged: ref:REF, or ref:[REF1,REF2]. Never JSON.stringify the ref or array, or put extra quote/bracket characters inside the ref string. Correct malformed arguments and retry read; do not search again for this input error. Method/Process/code-slot refs select saved text or Method bindings for their exact Implementation/Variant. BDE node refs return a local neighborhood. State refs return incoming/outgoing and code_slots; Transition refs return start_state/end_state/priority/code_slots. Order and duplicates are preserved. Refs are not Element References, Component OIDs or paths; do not invent IDs. No-ID Comment hits use parent Diagram/Hierarchy refs. Component refs cannot be read.

if_unchanged.description: For text/Diagram refs, true enforces the captured source revision and changed content fails with SOURCE_CHANGED. False returns current content with a SOURCE_CHANGED issue; root status is changed unless a read is incomplete or fails (partial). BDE node refs always enforce the saved Diagram revision. State/Transition object refs always enforce the saved topology/code-slot revision, even when false, to prevent native ID reuse. Re-discover after SOURCE_CHANGED.

debug.description: Include Component/code identity, Database, hash, coverage and timings for diagnostics. Leave false for ordinary reads.

include_graph.description: Add raw BDE Diagram facts. Whole-Diagram refs use graph.scope:diagram; BDE node refs use graph.scope:local. State/Transition object refs reject this option. A paginated local graph is a fragment: endpoint records may appear on other pages. Standard local connections already include endpoint names and refs.

lines.description: Inclusive saved text/diagram_text line range. end must be >= start and is clamped to line_count. Applies to every ref in a batch. BDE node refs use depth/direction instead. State/Transition object refs reject line ranges; their code_slots refs select saved text. Bindings have no body. Cannot combine with include_graph.

depth.description: BDE node refs only. 0 reads the target and all Pins; 1/2 expand one/two edge steps (default 1). Neighbor Pins are connected/boundary Pins; read a neighbor with depth:0 for its full interface. Use referenced_component_path with find.component to locate a real referenced Method. Does not expand Component implementations or cross Hierarchy boundaries.

direction.description: BDE node refs only: native edge direction for neighborhood traversal, not inferred data dependency. State/Transition object refs reject this option.

cursor.description: Copy a text, local Diagram or State/Transition relation read next_cursor unchanged. No other fields. The same immutable read snapshot is resumed. Batch items have independent cursors.
